title: PayloadRejectedPayload
description: Payload of the PayloadRejected event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

docsequence.description: The per-document monotonic sequence (INV-REQ-1221), duplicated in the payload alongside the envelope's own docsequence extension attribute.

validationTrace.description: The payload-build validation trace (opaque to this envelope; interpreted by console-bff and notification-svc).

packVersions.description: The pack versions a blocked verdict was computed from (the record of a BLOCK result, which the 422 error envelope of validateIssuance does not carry), one item per pack; no two items share a packType (producer-enforced). For a validation that ran Layer 1 an item with packType severity-override carries the version of the severity override pack applied (INV-REQ-499).

packType.description: A pack type name, for example severity-override.

code.description: The error-catalogue code that opened the exception (INV-REQ-940). Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.

remediationOwner.description: The effective owner of that code, as Exception.remediationOwner of console-bff/openapi.yaml (INV-REQ-940). Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.

decisions.description: The decision entry of a PAY-002 block (INV-REQ-1182, INV-REQ-3650): one entry per failed rule, recorded by evidence-svc as the system of record for traces. Optional: readers tolerate its absence (an event of another code, or from a producer that does not know it). The item shape equals DecisionTraceEntry of evidence/openapi.yaml.

assertionText.description: The business-language text of the failed assertion, written from the pack that failed it (INV-REQ-1182). Optional.

disposition.description: The base disposition of the code in the error catalogue, read as Exception.disposition of console-bff/openapi.yaml: AUTO_RELEASE, AUTO_RETRY, MANUAL, OVERRIDABLE, TERMINAL; extensible (INV-REQ-940). Absent when the producer does not know it; never guessed by the consumer.
